title: Session Luck Tracker
description: Counts every dice roll players make during a game session and posts the luckiest and unluckiest players to chat when the GM ends the session. Works with any system; Pathfinder 2e degree-of-success data is used when available.

recommends.reason: Optional: Pathfinder 2e degree-of-success data (critical successes / failures) is added to the statistics.
